nodes.label: Why the PHP harness suite was committed
nodes.rationale: Committed as three standalone CLI PHP harness suites (rewriter-test, convert-restore-e2e, bulk-e2e; 150 assertions total) because an earlier set of assertions lived only in a session scratchpad and was lost when that session ended, taking 143 assertions of regression cover with it. Standalone scripts rather than PHPUnit so they can run directly against real WordPress with a single php invocation.

nodes.label: Why every WordPress-backed harness checks siteurl first
nodes.rationale: harness_require_site() refuses to run unless get_option('siteurl') equals https://cb-test.local, because Local Sites names every database 'local' and distinguishes sites only by MySQL socket. Pairing the wrong socket with a site's files silently points the harness at a different site's database while everything appears to work, and has already produced two confidently-reported findings that were fiction plus a run that deleted 54 real user backups.
